title: the city goes dark on the bass
story: The dancehall riddim is hard and bright: the snare flashes the neon and every kick punches the layers apart, while the big hits add glass and a colour flash. At 5654 the section changes and the snare drops out; the centroid falls to the bass and the voice, so the city dims, the glass thickens and every bass note pushes the layers apart and opens contrast, with the hue drifting one step per bar. In the outro the riddim falls away and only the neon outlines remain.
